    FROM votes v

);

FROM posts_questions q
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts_answers a WHERE a.parent_id = q.post_id)

FROM comments
WHERE creation_date >= '2022-01-01' AND creation_date < '2023-01-01'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', creation_date)
ORDER BY month;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN creation_date >= '2021-01-01' AND creation_date < '2021-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q1_2021_questions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN creation_date >= '2022-01-01' AND creation_date < '2022-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q1_2022_questions,
  ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN creation_date >= '2021-01-01' AND creation_date < '2021-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN creation_date >= '2022-01-01' AND creation_date < '2022-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS difference,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN creation_date >= '2021-01-01' AND creation_date < '2021-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN creation_date >= '2022-01-01' AND creation_date < '2022-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'Q1 2021'
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN creation_date >= '2021-01-01' AND creation_date < '2021-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < SUM(CASE WHEN creation_date >= '2022-01-01' AND creation_date < '2022-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'Q1 2022'
    ELSE 'Equal'
  END AS more_questions_in
FROM posts_questions
WHERE (creation_date >= '2021-01-01' AND creation_date < '2021-04-01')
   OR (creation_date >= '2022-01-01' AND creation_date < '2022-04-01');

SELECT u.user_id, u.display_name, u.creation_date, COUNT(*) AS answers_2022

JOIN posts_answers a ON a.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE u.creation_date < '2012-01-01'
  AND a.creation_date >= '2022-01-01'
  AND a.creation_date < '2023-01-01'
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.display_name, u.creation_date
ORDER BY answers_2022 DESC
LIMIT 10;

  CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%w', creation_date) AS INTEGER) IN (0, 6) THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type,
  COUNT(*) AS question_count
FROM posts_questions
GROUP BY day_type

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage_with_accepted_answer
FROM posts_questions;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT pt.post_id) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts_questions) AS python_fraction
FROM post_tags pt
JOIN tags t ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id
JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = pt.post_id
WHERE t.tag_name = 'python'

SELECT t.tag_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT q.post_id) AS question_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL THEN q.post_id END) AS questions_with_accepted_answer,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL THEN q.post_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT q.post_id), 2) AS accepted_share_pct
FROM tags t
JOIN post_tags pt ON pt.tag_id = t.tag_id
JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = pt.post_id
GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name
ORDER BY question_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH tag_counts AS (
  SELECT t.tag_id,
         t.tag_name,
         SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', q.creation_date) = '2020' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q2020,
         SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', q.creation_date) = '2021' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q2021
  FROM tags t
  JOIN post_tags pt ON pt.tag_id = t.tag_id
  JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = pt.post_id
  WHERE strftime('%Y', q.creation_date) IN ('2020', '2021')
  GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_2021
  FROM posts_questions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', creation_date) = '2021'
)
SELECT tc.tag_name,
       tc.q2020,
       tc.q2021,
       tc.q2021 - tc.q2020 AS growth,
       ROUND(100.0 * tc.q2021 / total.total_2021, 2) AS pct_of_2021_questions
FROM tag_counts tc, total
WHERE tc.q2021

SELECT u.user_id, u.display_name, COUNT(*) AS total_answers, SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_accepted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted_answers, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_accepted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS accepted_share
FROM users u
JOIN posts_answers a ON a.user_id = u.user_id
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.display_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY accepted_share DESC, total_answers DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT q.user_id) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) AS proportion
FROM posts_questions q
WHERE q.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN score <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_zero_or_negative_score
FROM posts_questions;

SELECT strftime('%Y', q.creation_date) AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS total_questions,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts_answers a WHERE a.parent_id = q.post_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answered_questions,
       ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts_answers a WHERE a.parent_id = q.post_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS proportion_answered
FROM posts_questions q
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', q.creation_date)
ORDER BY year;

SELECT vote_type,
       COUNT(*) AS vote_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes), 2) AS percentage
FROM votes
GROUP BY vote_type
ORDER BY vote_count DESC;

WITH top_tags AS (
    SELECT t.tag_id, t.tag_name, COUNT(*) AS question_count
    FROM tags t
    JOIN post_tags pt ON pt.tag_id = t.tag_id
    GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name
    ORDER BY question_count DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
answerer_counts AS (
    SELECT tt.tag_id, tt.tag_name, tt.question_count, a.user_id, COUNT(*) AS answer_count
    FROM top_tags tt
    JOIN post_tags pt ON pt.tag_id = tt.tag_id
    JOIN posts_answers a ON a.parent_id = pt.post_id
    WHERE a.user_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY tt.tag_id, tt.tag_name, tt.question_count, a.user_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tag_id ORDER BY answer_count DESC, user_id) AS rn
    FROM answerer_counts
)
SELECT r.tag_name, r.rn AS rank, u.user_id, u.display_name, r.answer_count
FROM ranked r
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.user_id
WHERE r.rn <= 3
ORDER BY r.question_count DESC, r.tag_name, r.rn;

SELECT
  month,
  questions_in_month,
  SUM(questions_in_month) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
FROM (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', creation_date) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS questions_in_month
  FROM posts_questions
  GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', creation_date)
)
ORDER BY month;

SELECT year, post_id, title, score
FROM (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y', creation_date) AS year,
        post_id,
        title,
        score,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%Y', creation_date) ORDER BY score DESC) AS rnk
    FROM posts_questions
) 
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY year;

)

       LAG(question_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_count,
       question_count - LAG(question_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change_from_prev,
       ROUND(100.0 * (question_count - LAG(question_count) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(question_count) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS pct_change
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month;

    FROM tags t

ranked AS (
